declarations.name: AuiAccordion

inputs.name: items
inputs.description: Items with unique ids. Titles and string content render as text.

inputs.name: multiple
inputs.description: Allow several panels open at once; otherwise expanding one collapses the others.

inputs.name: collapsible
inputs.description: Single mode: the open panel can be collapsed. When false its header is aria-disabled.

inputs.name: headingLevel
inputs.description: Heading element wrapping each header button.

models.name: value
models.description: Expanded item ids (at most one when multiple is false).

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user expanded or collapsed an item.

methods.name: panel
methods.description: Content container of an item's panel.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Expand programmatically (no events); collapses others in single mode.

methods.name: collapse
methods.description: Collapse programmatically (no events), even when not collapsible.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Accordion pattern: native heading elements containing native buttons that control panels.

limitations: Collapsed panel content is removed from the find-in-page index (hidden attribute); hidden=until-found is not used.
The icon rotation and height transition are removed under reduced motion or animation 'none'; the rotated end state remains as a static indicator.
Changing `items` re-creates the item DOM; Node content is moved, not cloned.
